title: ExportManifest
description: manifest.json inside a .novaexport archive (FR-105, docs/12 §9, ADR-097 D5). The archive is a zip (ZIP64 when needed) holding one JSON-lines file per table (tables/<name>.jsonl), the data folder's files (files/<path>), in a sealed archive secrets.json, and this manifest last. With a passphrase the whole zip is sealed (scrypt, then AES-256-GCM in 1 MiB chunks) and carries the vault's secrets; without one they are left out and listed in toReEnter. An account-scoped archive is kept, not imported. An import checks format, schemaVersion (older migrates forward, newer is refused) and every checksum. Mirrors exportManifestSchema in packages/shared/src/m8/datactl.ts.

format.description: The archive format; this build writes and reads 1.

schemaVersion.description: The number of the last migration the exporting Hub had applied.

accountScope.description: "hub": the whole Hub, every account on it (the owner's export, importable). {accountId}: one account's own data, exported by the owner for a removed member before the purge (never sealed, carries no secrets, and refused by import with account_scope).

dataDir.description: The exporting Hub's data folder: an import moves absolute paths under it to its own.

blobs.description: Files of the data folder, by path relative to it.

seal.description: The label the importing Hub seals the file with again: it was stored encrypted with the Hub's data key and travels decrypted.

raw.description: The file travels still sealed (only in a sealed archive, whose secrets hold that key).

secrets.description: In a sealed archive: how many vault entries secrets.json holds, and its SHA-256; null otherwise.

toReEnter.description: secret:// references left out of an archive without a passphrase, to enter again after an import.

omitted.description: What was left out and why (secrets, the Hub's own key tables, cookie jars, push subscriptions without a passphrase).
